newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks drift in dull London trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks drift in dull London trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London drifted in dull trading on Friday, marginally extending the Hang Seng's record close in Hong Kong, traders said.

London's Hang Seng Reference Index closed was up 14.63 points at 12,524.68. In Hong Kong the Hang Seng index closed up 73.25 points at a record high of 12,510.05, on confident buying after Wall Street's record close on Thursday. Traders said the market in London was drifting because the Hong Kong holiday on Monday had made investors nervous about taking positions over the weekend, and because Wall Street had eased at today's opening.
Yet the market is expected to continue on its upward trend next week, tracking U.S. long bonds. By 1454 GMT the benchmark 30-year issue was up 5/16 at 99-21/32.
"The market should go slightly higher next week," one trader said. "There's still plenty of liquidity sloshing around."
Among banking shares, HSBC Holdings rose slightly to close at HK$155.425, ahead of its overnight Hong Kong close of HK$155.0.
